bioParagraphs: I am a results-driven Software Developer with 5+ years of hands-on experience in Laravel, Vue.js, MySQL, and modern frontend frameworks. Skilled in building scalable web applications, institutional university ICT systems, and high-volume financial solutions.

Currently serving as a System Programmer at Tai Solarin University of Education (TASUED) ICT, where I architect and maintain mission-critical systems serving over 20,000 students and staff, including student portals (V4 & V3), LMS platforms (LMS TASCE), and cryptographically secure collegiate e-voting infrastructure.
Previously at Autocredit Payments, I developed and maintained automated instant payment solutions processing approximately 10 billion NGN annually with high reliability, security, and low latency.
I am actively open to relocation and eager to contribute my full-stack engineering expertise to Canada’s growing digital economy and forward-thinking technology organizations worldwide.

projects.title: LMS TASCE
projects.subtitle: Institutional Learning Management System & Academic Portal
projects.shortDesc: Enterprise academic digital learning management system supporting curriculum delivery, lecture materials, continuous assessment tests, and student grade tracking.
projects.overview: LMS TASCE modernizes tertiary education delivery by providing students and lecturers with a centralized, high-availability platform for digital coursework, virtual submissions, and examination management.
projects.challenge: Handling peak concurrent login traffic during examination windows and assignment deadlines without server degradation.
projects.solution: Architected optimized database queries with session clustering and edge caching, resulting in seamless response times even during peak academic cycles.
achievements: Digitized over 240 active college courses across multiple academic departments
Reduced manual grading turnaround time by 65%
Maintained 99.9% uptime during nationwide semester examinations

projects.title: Online Efiko
projects.subtitle: Interactive Gamified Student Learning & Exam Preparation Platform
projects.shortDesc: Gamified edtech platform empowering students with simulated mock exams, timed challenges, performance analytics, and interactive reward systems.
projects.overview: Online Efiko transforms standard exam preparation into an engaging, gamified journey with real-time peer challenges, XP leaderboards, and AI-assisted performance insights.
projects.challenge: Balancing real-time leaderboard computations with ultra-low latency test delivery on mobile devices with variable internet connections.
projects.solution: Built an offline-first caching strategy with optimistic state updates and background synchronization for quiz results.
achievements: Boosted average student exam preparedness test scores by 34%
Implemented real-time multiplayer quiz duel functionality
Over 50,000 active mock questions categorized by subject and topic

projects.title: Tasued website
projects.subtitle: Official Institutional University Web Platform & Information Gateway
projects.shortDesc: The primary digital portal for Tai Solarin University of Education, serving students, faculty, alumni, and global visitors with high accessibility.
projects.overview: The official university website acts as the flagship digital interface for TASUED, integrating news bulletins, admissions portals, faculty directories, and institutional announcements.
projects.challenge: Delivering responsive, lightning-fast page loads to hundreds of thousands of concurrent visitors during admissions and matriculation announcements.
projects.solution: Refactored the frontend architecture with responsive media loading, optimized asset pipelines, and structured SEO markup.
achievements: Achieved 96+ Google Lighthouse performance rating across mobile and desktop
Streamlined access to university faculties, colleges, and academic calendars
Integrated dynamic announcements and institutional press release channels

projects.title: E-voting
projects.subtitle: Cryptographically Secure Collegiate Electronic Voting & Audit System
projects.shortDesc: Next-generation electronic balloting and election telemetry platform featuring biometric student verification, zero-knowledge tallying, and live dashboard metrics.
projects.overview: Built for institutional student union and council elections, this system ensures 100% transparency, voter confidentiality, and immediate result publication.
projects.challenge: Preventing duplicate voting, credential stuffing, and vote tampering under high-stress election deadlines.
projects.solution: Engineered single-use cryptographic token authentication, audit log hashing, and real-time WebSocket telemetry for live public tally screens.
achievements: Conducted successful campus-wide elections with zero ballot irregularities
Cut ballot counting and auditing time from 14 hours to under 30 seconds
Praised by election observers and faculty leadership for absolute transparency

projects.title: V4 Tasued Portal
projects.subtitle: Fourth-Generation Student Information System & Administrative Gateway
projects.shortDesc: Flagship modern student portal managing end-to-end academic lifecycles: course registration, fee clearance, exam docket generation, and transcript requests.
projects.overview: The V4 Portal is the core administrative spine of the university, handling multi-tier authentication for students, bursary officers, course advisors, and registrars.
projects.challenge: Migrating complex legacy database schemas while ensuring zero downtime and total transactional integrity for financial tuition payments.
projects.solution: Designed idempotent payment webhooks, database indexing, and modern reactive authentication middleware.
achievements: Processes millions in tuition and fee clearances with zero transaction discrepancy
Automated semester course docket generation and verification QR codes
Reduced administrative query queues at the ICT center by over 70%

projects.title: V3 Tasued Portal
projects.subtitle: Legacy Core Authentication & Academic Records System
projects.shortDesc: High-throughput legacy institutional authentication infrastructure supporting multi-tiered university student service operations.
projects.overview: The V3 system provided the trusted bedrock of university student identity, exam records, and alumni verification over numerous academic sessions.
projects.challenge: Maintaining and securing high-volume legacy PHP codebases while keeping them compatible with modern server stacks and browser security headers.
projects.solution: Hardened SQL queries against injection vulnerabilities, implemented secure cookie protocols, and tuned database connection pooling.
achievements: Maintained uninterrupted service for thousands of graduating student cohorts
Serves as the authoritative verification registry for alumni records
Seamless bridge to the next-generation V4 infrastructure

projects.title: Fast and Fun
projects.subtitle: Dynamic Event & Entertainment Experience Platform
projects.shortDesc: Vibrant consumer entertainment platform featuring event bookings, interactive ticketing, media showcases, and customer engagement.
projects.overview: Fast and Fun delivers an exciting, high-energy digital brand presence for extreme sports and recreational entertainment in Canada.
projects.challenge: Creating an exhilarating visual design that captures real-world adrenaline while keeping checkout friction down to under 60 seconds.
projects.solution: Crafted kinetic animations, mobile-first booking flows, and instant calendar date pickers integrated with secure digital payment processing.
achievements: Increased online booking conversion rates by 45% within the first month
Silky 60fps micro-animations on mobile browsers
Integrated dynamic Google Maps location tracking and customer review feeds

projects.title: Wizard Ai
projects.subtitle: Generative Artificial Intelligence Multi-Tool & Prompt Assistant
projects.shortDesc: Intelligent AI assistant platform powered by modern LLMs for automated copywriting, code generation, creative reasoning, and workflow acceleration.
projects.overview: Wizard AI leverages generative deep learning to automate repetitive developer and content workflows through a sleek, responsive conversational interface.
projects.challenge: Implementing seamless token streaming and markdown code syntax highlighting without rendering bottlenecks.
projects.solution: Utilized Nuxt.js Edge Runtime with streaming response pipelines and client-side syntax highlighting.
achievements: Open-sourced on GitHub with clean developer documentation
Integrated multi-model prompt switching and conversation history persistence
Deployed globally on Vercel Edge Network
